The `get_item` and `query` tools were already available. I'll list all items, including discontinued ones.

Now I need per-warehouse stock for the relevant SKUs, plus ticket 1103. It has an `RMA-1103` shipment, so its serial may matter.

Next is 1133. West now holds 0, so the most-stocked other warehouse is north (4).

All shipments are recorded. Now I'll add the comments, using idempotency keys.

The comment on 1106 hit ECONNRESET, so I can't tell whether it was saved. I'll retry with the same idempotency key, which can't create a duplicate.

The retry returned `c-6`, timestamped before `c-7`. The original call had succeeded, and the retry added no duplicate. Now the statuses.

My summary said 13 shipments, but the count is 14 (`adj-107` to `adj-120`). I'll correct it.
